key_insight: Insulin4RL is a new ICU insulin-management dataset built from real, irregular clinical trajectories to better support offline reinforcement learning research.
clinical_relevance: It may help researchers evaluate insulin titration models under more realistic hospital conditions than fixed-interval EHR data.
method: Includes over 375,000 labelled insulin decisions from 12,209 patients
Uses fitted Q-evaluation and baseline model-free offline RL for assessment
evidence_signal: The dataset captures naturally irregular inputs and actions, providing a standardized evaluation setup for offline reinforcement learning in insulin infusion titration.
watch_item: Because it is retrospective and built for research evaluation, results may not generalize directly to real-time bedside use without careful validation.
paper_title: Insulin4RL: Real-Time Insulin Management in the Intensive Care Unit for Offline Reinforcement Learning
